name: MRO HUD
author: OpenRevo Community
description: [Note] This plugin must be installed together with "MRO HUD · Settings"; installed on its own you cannot adjust the appearance or 1% Low, and full functionality is unavailable. Please download the other plugin as well. [MRO HUD main plugin] A desktop floating HUD: GPU/CPU temperature, clocks, fans, power, utilization, VRAM and memory, plus FPS / frametime / 1% Low. Ported from mro_monitor. Appearance and 1% Low settings are changed in the companion "MRO HUD · Settings" tab.

service.description: Read-only sensor agent: RTSS shared-memory FPS/frametime + system memory usage, and it starts RTSS automatically when it is not running
